name: animotion
description: Animated scenes for single-file HTML: slideware decks, knowledgebase pages or any page. Each scene is one isolated <am-scene> element whose timeline of verbs (enter, move, clone, type, count, set state) runs on one seekable clock, so it plays while it can be seen and otherwise rests on a poster frame for print, export, thumbnails and reduced motion. Scenes follow a visual language derived from a brand, a named drawing idiom or a reference; a curated index of online icon, illustration and motion sources lists what may be fetched and how to credit it. A CLI inlines the runtime, checks scenes in Chrome and draws contact sheets of their frames.
